Dream 2026-11-22 suggests a refinement: broaden.

**What the vignettes add.** The pointing runs both ways and is specific, not just focus awareness. 35e35dd2: 'I need to be able to point at a specific element... In reverse, I also need an agent to be able to point at something specific', with comments highlighting specific words and each comment linked to its highlight. 8146f8f6 adds an agent highlighting a UI component. 179ab139 adds that agents must see what changed so they do not 'distract with details in areas that are not the current focus'.

**Proposed.** The writer and the agents cannot point at the same thing: an agent can only learn where the writer is working by polling, and neither side can single out a specific paragraph or word for the other. Help arrives about the wrong thing at the wrong time, and general comments replace direct ones.

**Depth.** Three vignettes on 2026-10-26 and 2026-10-29; the pointing concern recurs in both directions (writer to agent, agent to writer, agent to UI). The 10-26 vignette is about change visibility and only touches this problem.

If you agree, the change is made by succession: a successor that supersedes this record, which stays as it is.
